correctness.rationale: The theorem is restricted to a nonempty general open of characteristic-zero quartic Kummer surfaces with exactly sixteen ordinary nodes, and a separate explicit rational symmetric tetrahedroid witness for the length-19 defect. For the specified quartic F=3(2X²+2Y²+2Z²-3W²)²-28(W+X+Y+Z)(W+X-Y-Z)(W-X+Y-Z)(W-X-Y+Z), an independent exact symbolic substitution verified F=grad F=0 at the sixteen listed projective nodes; the affine 3x3 Hessian determinant is -693633024 at four and -11098128384 at twelve, so each is an ordinary double point. Independent modular evaluation/first-jet ranks recovered degree-3/4/5/6/7 jets 20,34,52,64,64, yielding the doubled-point Hilbert function 1,4,10,20,34,52,64,... and length 64. The actual pinned verifier constructs Gröbner checks for no extra critical points at infinity, rational I3 and I4 kernels, P6 and F*R2 degree-6 generators, F*R3 and P6*R1 degree-7 spans, and exact modular-rank bounds at 1009,1013 for rank20,rank56 and degree8 ordinary-square rank101; its algorithm and rational inclusions were inspected, not blindly treated as a VERIFY_OK log. Projective 7-regularity from the Hilbert stabilization plus equality through degree seven proves the all-degree ideal I^(2)=(F)+G²=I²+(F) for the witness. Lower semicontinuity of full-rank minors in finite marking families, combined with universal inclusions/upper dimension bounds, gives a nonempty general Zariski-open of Jacobian Kummer quartics satisfying that ideal and Hilbert function, not the exact length-19 defect globally. For the rational witness the ordinary-square degree7 rank52 and degree8 full rank imply cyclic defect dimensions (1,4,10,4) in degrees4..7, sum19. Finite witness ranks alone do not prove a claim about every special Kummer or generic defect.
